name: Draft Feedback Request
problem: I want to ask for feedback in a professional way, but I am not sure how to make the request clear, specific, and easy to respond to.
when_to_use: Use when asking a manager, mentor, teammate, or reviewer for feedback on work, communication, or growth areas.
use_cases: ask my manager for feedback on a presentation
request review comments on a project draft
ask a mentor for growth feedback
write a message requesting specific and actionable feedback
instructions: Given the situation and the type of feedback needed, write a polite and professional feedback request. Make the request specific enough to guide a useful response, and keep the message concise and respectful of the other person's time.

example.input: I want to ask my manager for feedback on whether my project updates are clear and whether I am focusing on the right priorities.
example.output: Hi, I wanted to ask if you would be open to sharing feedback on how I have been communicating project updates so far. I would especially appreciate any thoughts on whether my updates are clear and whether I am focusing on the right priorities. Thank you.
